verdict.rationale: Foreloop lets users describe problems in plain language (e.g., 'Users can't tell which invoices are overdue') which an agent turns into structured intentions/tasks, and its feedback widget captures free-text descriptions of issues (docs-4, docs-12, docs-21, docs-23). However, the primary interface for operating the product itself is a structured CLI (foreloop, --json, init) rather than a natural-language command layer, so full conversational operation isn't evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of a chat/NL interface for issuing arbitrary commands (approving contracts, managing projects) rather than just NL problem descriptions feeding a pipeline.
